Accessibility

Designed to be readable, navigable, and usable.

Last updated: 28 October 2026

Navigation and reading

The site provides a skip-to-content link, semantic headings, text descriptions for meaningful images, and visible keyboard focus. Navigation, filters, and expandable sections can be operated with a keyboard.

Display preferences

Layouts adapt to small screens and enlarged text. The theme control switches between light and dark views for the current page. The site respects reduced-motion settings, and core content remains available when JavaScript is disabled.

Documents and third-party pages

The downloadable résumé includes selectable text. Original third-party certificates and external websites may have different accessibility characteristics. A course directory provides text titles and issuer details alongside certificate links.

Feedback

If something prevents you from using the site, email aliawais4413@gmail.com with the page and the problem. These design measures do not constitute a formal accessibility certification.
